source: Owner message containing 13 campaign-associated donation/comment records

records.name: Amanda Reynolds
records.comment: Jeremiah, your determination to walk again is incredible. Wishing you strength through every step of your recovery.

records.name: Brandon Mitchell
records.comment: No young person should have to face so much. I hope this contribution helps with your treatment.

records.name: Sophia Bennett
records.comment: Your story touched my heart. Sending love and encouragement to you and your family.

records.name: Nathan Brooks
records.comment: Keep holding on to your dreams, Jeremiah. You deserve all the support you can get.

records.name: Olivia Harrison
records.comment: Praying for your health and hoping more people come together to support your recovery.

records.name: Christopher Wilson
records.comment: Your courage throughout surgery, chemotherapy, and rehabilitation deserves recognition. Wishing you the best.

records.name: Emily Parker
records.comment: I hope this helps ease some of the financial pressure on your family. Sending strength.

records.name: Matthew Collins
records.comment: The fact that you graduated while facing cancer is remarkable. Keep pursuing your future.

records.name: Rachel Thompson
records.comment: Your journey is heartbreaking, but your determination is inspiring. Sending you kindness and support.

records.name: Daniel Foster
records.comment: I hope this donation contributes toward your continued medical care and rehabilitation.

records.name: Jessica Morgan
records.comment: Every step of recovery matters. Wishing you comfort and strength during treatment.

records.name: William Anderson
records.comment: I cannot imagine everything your family has been through. Hoping this support helps lighten the burden.

records.name: Lauren Edwards
records.comment: Jeremiah, I hope your story reaches many more people who can help you continue receiving care.
